svg.text: Training Evidence Decision Value — Evidence Boundary

g.text: Observed RE78 difference: 1,794.34 historical 1982 U.S. dollars.
Dense frontier: 0–4,000 by 100; 50% exceedance frontier reaches 1,700.
Thresholds are illustrative scenarios, not observed program costs or modern L&D break-even values.
Bootstrap exceedance fractions are not posterior probabilities; the label permutation is a diagnostic, not exact design reconstruction.
Transport from this historical program and population to modern corporate training requires separate evidence.
